offence_note: Trafficking in fentanyl causing six overdoses
sentence_quote: Mr. Chesshire, I sentence you to nine months in custody, and pursuant to s. 731 of the Criminal Code, a term of probation for two years that will begin at the conclusion of the nine month custodial sentence.
note: Probation includes curfew; cocaine count stayed.

offence_note: Trafficking crack cocaine and possession of proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: We set aside the victim surcharge ordered by the trial judge and direct that any money that may have been paid be remitted to the appellant.
note: Sentence appeal dismissed except victim surcharge set aside.

offence_note: Sexual assault and transmitting child pornography
sentence_quote: So, the overall combined net sentence for both offences is 13 months and 25.5 days' imprisonment.
note: Child pornography coded other; mitigating circumstances unspecified in shown text; 12 months plus 2 months consecutive; credit 4.5 days.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking marihuana and cocaine
sentence_quote: I suspend the passing of sentence and place you on a term of probation for 30 months.
note: Suspended sentence with 30 months probation including six months house arrest; mitigating factors only partly shown.

offence_note: Break and enter, sexual assault, threat to injure animal
sentence_quote: I am satisfied that there has been no error demonstrated in the approach of the learned sentencing judge in this case and, accordingly, I would grant leave to appeal from sentence but I would dismiss the appeal from sentence.
note: Five years imposed on break and enter count.

offence_note: Obstruction of justice by false identity
sentence_quote: The leave is granted. The appeal is allowed and the sentence is reduced to a period of one year.
note: Reduced from 18 months because seven months pre-trial custody was not considered.

offence_note: Conspiracy to commit murder (planned mall shooting)
sentence_quote: After considering and weighing a broad range of relevant factors, he decided the maximum sentence of life imprisonment should be imposed.
note: Mitigating factors given limited weight; parole ineligibility not shown.

sentence_quote: an acquittal shall be entered on count seven and the appellant’s total sentence shall be reduced by three years.
note: 3.5 years concurrent plus 3 years consecutive on quashed count; reduced to 3.5 years.

sentence_quote: I would grant Mr. Kehoe leave to appeal his sentence, allow the appeal and sentence him to four years' imprisonment less time served.
systemic_quote: On a proper application of Gladue principles, I consider Mr. Kehoe to have a significantly reduced level of moral blameworthiness.
note: Reduced from five years; credit of 260 days at 1.5 given at trial.

offence_note: Rape, indecent assault and incest against two daughters
sentence_quote: three years concurrent on count 2; for the offence of incest in relation to L. N., three years consecutive; for the rape of L. N., three years concurrent; and for the offence of indecent assault on L. N., two years concurrent, for a total sentence of eight years.
note: 77 days remand taken into account in global sentence; treatment program recommended.
